trust_decision.summary: Which SnakeYAML constructor parses externally supplied YAML: YamlHelper.newYaml() (and new Yaml(LoaderOptions)/newYamlRepresenter(Constructor,...)) build the full Constructor that honours !!<java class> tags, while newYamlSafeConstructor() restricts to standard types; the choice is made per call site.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'non-safe yaml deserialization'; the shared YAML factory and its unsafe newYaml() is the obvious first stop, and grepping its callers yields the published sites.

fix_sites.entry_point: keel HTTP POST /delivery-configs/validate with a YAML content type, via DeliveryConfigYamlParsingFilter (keel/keel-web/src/main/kotlin/com/netflix/spinnaker/keel/rest/DeliveryConfigYamlParsingFilter.kt:37, registered at keel/keel-web/src/main/kotlin/com/netflix/spinnaker/config/DefaultConfiguration.kt:128)
fix_sites.module_kind: servlet filter helper in a core util file (keel-core)

fix_sites.entry_point: secret decryption of an encrypted:<storage>!...!k:<key> reference at config load in any service (AbstractStorageSecretEngine.decrypt, kork/kork-secrets/src/main/java/com/netflix/spinnaker/kork/secrets/engines/AbstractStorageSecretEngine.java:42-62)

rosco HTTP POST /api/v2/manifest/bake/{type} for the CloudFoundry template type (rosco/rosco-web/src/main/groovy/com/netflix/spinnaker/rosco/controllers/V2BakeryController.java:29); vars artifacts are loaded at line 82
orca Deploy CloudFormation pipeline stage task; dump() only (serialisation), so no load of untrusted YAML happens here
same stage, List templateBody shape; dump() only
public static API YamlHelper.newYaml(); fix only adds @Deprecated and a warning log (fix.diff:50-54), it stays unsafe
fix_sites.module_kind: shared factory (kork-core), not a behavioural fix

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Secret files live in operator-owned S3/GCS buckets referenced from service config, so a solver can call them trusted configuration rather than attacker input; likewise for the uncovered routes: keel's readValueInliningAliases is 'just alias inlining' that calls the safer-sounding newYamlLoaderOptions, and the kustomize reader uses a typed Constructor(Kustomization.class) that looks bound to one class.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: YAML anchors/aliases must keep resolving for delivery configs (the reason snakeyaml is used at all), and Kustomization files must still bind to the typed Kustomization model; replacing the typed Constructor with SafeConstructor returns a Map and breaks kustomize bakes, while rejecting all tags or dropping aliases breaks legitimate configs.

O6_input_shapes: InputStream body (keel filter, secrets file, CF vars artifacts)
templateBody as Map vs List of documents (CloudFormation dump, cosmetic)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: keel delivery-config parse: readValueInliningAliases uses newYamlLoaderOptions, which builds new Yaml(LoaderOptions) with the full Constructor; reached from POST /delivery-configs/upsertGate, /validate, validate/gate and the SCM importer, and parsing happens before the permission check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same file as a fixed line but goes through a different, LoaderOptions-named factory that looks like the hardened one; the advisory names newYaml().
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix site; root cause in kork-core YamlHelper.java:129-135 (other module); callers at keel/keel-web/src/main/kotlin/com/netflix/spinnaker/keel/rest/DeliveryConfigController.kt:95,187 and keel/keel-igor/src/main/kotlin/com/netflix/spinnaker/keel/igor/DeliveryConfigImporter.kt:43

O8_uncovered_routes.route: rosco kustomize bake: Kustomization file downloaded from an artifact is loaded with YamlHelper.newYamlRepresenter(new Constructor(Kustomization.class), ...), the full Constructor, which still honours explicit class tags under SnakeYAML 1.33
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Typed root Constructor looks like it can only produce a Kustomization, and the call does not use newYaml(); the advisory's CF bake fix is in a sibling package.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: rosco-manifests kustomize package vs fixed cloudfoundry package; reached via rosco/rosco-manifests/src/main/java/com/netflix/spinnaker/rosco/manifests/kustomize/KustomizeTemplateUtils.java:198 from POST /api/v2/manifest/bake/{type}

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ThreadLocal yamlParser built with the full-Constructor factory for user manifest artifacts (loadAll at line 162)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same ThreadLocal.withInitial(YamlHelper.newYaml...) idiom repeated in several orca tasks; a one-word factory choice.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Jenkins build property-file YAML parse using an unsafe factory
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Build-output properties are parsed as YAML with a fallback to java.util.Properties; a maintainer could easily pick the default factory.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: how-type: factory variants (newYamlLoaderOptions/newYamlRepresenter) that silently pick the full Constructor
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already exists at pinned commit; the javadoc at lines 33-38 even recommends newYaml() as 'secure'.

O9_family: unsafe deserialization (SnakeYAML full Constructor / arbitrary class instantiation, CWE-502/CWE-470)

O10_build.toolchain: Gradle monorepo (root gradlew + settings.gradle, per-service composite builds); SnakeYAML pinned 1.33; JDK version not checked
O10_build.project_tests: kork/kork-core/src/test/java/com/netflix/spinnaker/kork/yaml/YamlHelperTest.java exists; fix adds YamlHelperInjectionTest (fix.diff:58-346) which is absent at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace every YamlHelper.newYaml() call with newYamlSafeConstructor() and stop, leaving newYamlLoaderOptions (keel) and the typed Constructor in the kustomize reader on the full Constructor.
